Title: Subscribe with a new valid email
Preconditions: Signup form is visible; email not yet subscribed
Steps:
1. Open the page with the newsletter signup form
2. Enter qa.user01@example.com
3. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Success confirmation is shown (assumed text: 'Thank you for subscribing'); email stored as a subscriber; form cleared/disabled to prevent resubmission

Title: Show 'Already subscribed' for duplicate email
Expected Result: Message exactly "Already subscribed" shown; no second subscriber record created

Title: Subscribe with plus-addressed and subdomain email
Expected Result: Email accepted as valid; success confirmation shown; subscriber record created with the exact address

Title: Submit via Enter key
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Press Enter in the email field
Expected Result: Form submits same as clicking Subscribe; success confirmation shown

Title: Reject Subscribe with empty email
Steps:
1. Leave email field empty
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Validation error shown on email field (e.g. 'Please enter a valid email'); no subscriber created; no API call returns 201

Title: Reject email missing @ symbol
Expected Result: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

Title: Reject script injection in email field
Expected Result: Rejected as invalid format; no script executes; payload is not reflected unescaped in page; nothing stored

Title: Reject SQL injection string in email field
Expected Result: Rejected as invalid format (or safely handled); no DB error exposed; subscriber table unchanged

Title: Reject email missing domain
Expected Result: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

Title: Reject email missing local part
Expected Result: Invalid email format error shown; no subscriber created

Title: Reject email with multiple @ or internal spaces
Steps:
1. Enter Email A, click Subscribe
2. Enter Email B, click Subscribe
Expected Result: Both rejected with invalid email format error; no subscriber created
Test Data: Email A = qa@@example.com; Email B = qa user@example.com

Title: Invalid format takes precedence over duplicate check
Expected Result: Invalid format error shown, not "Already subscribed"; nothing stored

Title: 'Already subscribed' message does not appear for new email
Expected Result: Success confirmation shown; "Already subscribed" not displayed

Title: Double-click Subscribe creates only one subscription
Preconditions: Signup form is visible; email not subscribed
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Rapidly double-click Subscribe
Expected Result: Exactly one subscriber record created; user sees the success message (not 'Already subscribed' from the second request); button disabled while request is in flight

Title: Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed
Steps:
1. Enter the email with surrounding spaces
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Assumed: spaces trimmed and qa.trim@example.com stored; success shown (if not trimmed, a format error is shown, never a stored value with spaces)

Title: Network failure during Subscribe shows retryable error
Preconditions: Signup form is visible; browser DevTools set to Offline
Steps:
1. Enter the email
2. Go offline
3. Click Subscribe
4. Go online and click Subscribe again
Expected Result: Generic error shown on failure without losing entered email; retry succeeds with one subscriber record

Title: Duplicate detection is case-insensitive
Steps:
1. Enter the mixed-case email
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Assumed: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record (pending confirmation of case rule)

Title: Duplicate with surrounding spaces still detected
Steps:
1. Enter the email with spaces
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record with spaces created

Title: 100 chars plus surrounding spaces counted after trim
Steps:
1. Enter the padded email
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Consistent with trim rule: accepted if length is measured after trim; behaviour matches the API length check

Title: Internationalised (unicode) email handling
Expected Result: Handled consistently per decision on IDN/unicode support (open question): either accepted and stored without mojibake, or rejected with the invalid format error; no server error

Title: Different plus-alias is not treated as duplicate
Expected Result: Assumed: treated as a distinct address; success shown; new record created

Title: Accept email of exactly 100 characters
Expected Result: Accepted; success confirmation shown; stored value is the full 100 chars (not truncated)

Title: Reject email of 101 characters
Steps:
1. Paste the 101-char email (bypasses maxlength if any)
2. Click Subscribe
Expected Result: Either input is limited to 100 chars by the field, or a 'max 100 characters' error is shown; no 101-char email stored

Title: Accept email of 99 characters
Expected Result: Accepted; success confirmation shown; full value stored

Title: Accept shortest valid email
Expected Result: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown
